name: naoto24kawa-claude-plugins
description: Code review, Claude Code configuration review, Notion integration, GitHub workflow automation, remote Chrome control, notification, development process infrastructure, accessibility review, Issue-to-PR automation, and virtual consulting team plugins for development workflows

plugins.name: automation
plugins.description: GitHub Issue auto-classification, implementation, and PR creation workflow automation with browser verification and screenshot integration

plugins.name: minio-plan-files
plugins.description: MinIO (S3-compatible) + ElasticMQ (SQS-compatible) based plan file sharing and task queue for AI agents. Provides skills for plan submission (Dispatcher), fetching, completion, failure handling, and status monitoring (Agent workflow). Includes an MCP server for native tool integration.

plugins.name: notify
plugins.description: Notification plugin for simple-notify-tools with automatic hook registration. Sends Stop (task completion) and Notification (input prompt) events via bundled notify.sh. Includes setup skill for LAN configuration, server health check, and test notifications. Supports AI summarization.

plugins.name: observability
plugins.description: AI self-healing system observability design setup and continuous audit. Guides pattern selection (AWS/Cloudflare x single/microservices), confirms trace_id/repair design decisions, and audits code compliance against the design document.

plugins.name: dev-process
plugins.description: Development process infrastructure and specification management plugin. Sets up CLAUDE.md rules, Issue/PR templates, GitHub Actions quality gates. Orchestrates 9 specialized sub-agents for spec generation, incremental updates, drift detection, and process auditing. Includes ECC pattern review and security review context for diff-based security workflows.

plugins.name: plugin-dev
plugins.description: Plugin development tools for diagnosing and fixing skill errors, validating plugin structure, and improving skill quality. Includes Stop hook for automatic error detection and specialized agents for syntax fixing, workflow debugging, and quality improvement.

plugins.name: accessibility
plugins.description: Web accessibility (a11y) code review agent based on WCAG 2.2 (A/AA/AAA). Analyzes HTML, JSX, TSX, Vue, Svelte and CSS for accessibility violations with specific fix suggestions.

plugins.name: consulting
plugins.description: Virtual consulting team with 7 specialized advisors for software product decisions. Covers legal, pricing, tech architecture, security, marketing, product/UX, and finance — supporting both individual developers and enterprise teams.
